requirements: Host observes actual PID/parent/group/start/launch before release; stand-in parent==group-owner is invalid for ACP.
Admit each selected original caller and exact one-attempt argv/env/cwd/native identity before payload effects; cover permitted-executable bypass.
Kernel task budget counts threads and encloses helper, checked ACP and descendants; deny migration/controller changes before untrusted entry.
Transport and canonical absent/disabled/managed-deny fixtures must compose with actual prepared ACP on the chosen platform.
Keep native/driver/helper software waits, adoptee rights, pidfd/cgroup settlement and fixture cleanup separate.
Bind ACP installed compatible Node and Python inputs independently of SDK22 evidence; preserve trusted-host/system-loader boundary.

edgeClasses.acpCallers: All four child_process import parents per hop require selected-call/argv classification; graph reachability cannot label ACP auth/status/index callers unreachable.
edgeClasses.addons: Node --no-addons is required; original embedded native addon/dynamic-loader behavior remains opaque.
edgeClasses.capturedImport: Exact retained ESM/CJS/JSON static closure; resolution misses refuse. This is not complete semantic/native closure.
edgeClasses.childProcess: Production facade mediates held native path/hash and bounded caller ps; permits spawn/spawnSync/execFile/execFileSync. Exact argv/env/cwd/stdio/detached policy, one-shot and pre-entry release are NOT supplied by path matching.
edgeClasses.dynamicCode: Node startup disallows string code generation. Function cautions remain selected-compatibility unknowns; do not relax flags from fake success.
edgeClasses.fakeRecipe: Accepted first-party recipe substitutes f902 caller-bound one-shot facade and Python entry. It does not attest the original SDK launch argv or native behavior.
edgeClasses.native: Frozen native SHA/size by hop/platform identifies bytes only. Descendant exec, workers, dynamic code and permitted-executable argv bypass remain opaque/unadmitted; no further native disassembly is inferred.
edgeClasses.rawProcess: getBuiltinModule is disabled by production bootstrap, but process.binding/_linkedBinding/execve are not established blocked there. Broad normal builtins remain capabilities; no hostile-JavaScript sandbox claim.
edgeClasses.startup: Checked host binds prefix/runtime/source identities and rejects unsafe startup environment before spawn. This is not a kernel payload sandbox.
edgeClasses.workerVm: Absent worker_threads/vm module edges refuse captured resolution. This proves no original-native/ambient-process worker prohibition.
